topic: Range-based for Loop in Modern C++
explanation: The range-based for loop is a modern C++ feature introduced in C++11 that provides a concise and readable syntax for iterating over all elements in a container or range. It simplifies iteration by abstracting away the need for explicit iterator management, reducing boilerplate code, and minimizing errors related to iterator boundaries. This construct enhances code clarity and safety, especially when working with standard library containers and user-defined ranges.
keywords: C++ foreach, range-based for, for auto in container, simplified iteration
